content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am interested in purchasing six [product_name] basic modules and one [product_name] operator device. Is it possible to switch between the six controllers using the up and down keys on the operator device? Thank you.

No, an operator device can only communicate with one [product_name] at a time. If you wish to use it with a different controller, you need to manually select the desired [product_name] through the operator device menu.
Another question: Can the operator device connect to the [product_name] basic module with the pure version?
It does not matter whether the [product_name] basic module includes a display or not.

As [user_name] mentioned, the operator device is only able to connect with one [product_name] controller at a time unless reconfigured. However, the controllers can easily exchange data with each other. This allows data from all six controllers to be shown on your operator device.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is planning to purchase several [company_name] [product_name] basic modules and an operator device, and asked about switching between multiple controllers using navigation keys on the operator device. Replies clarify that direct switching with the keys is not supported; the operator device only connects to one controller at a time, unless a different module is manually selected in the menu. Nevertheless, it is possible for controllers to share data among themselves, allowing information from several controllers to be viewed on the operator device.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to easily switch control and view between multiple [product_name] basic modules using navigation keys on a single operator device, without needing to manually make menu changes.
